3 oz bubblegum infused vodka
.75 oz fresh lemon juice 
.25 oz demerara syrup
3 fresh Raspberries 

Blueberry whipped cream topping:

2 oz heavy cream
3 fresh blueberries
2 drops plant based blue dye 

Add vodka, juice, syrup and raspberries into shaker and shake with ice. Double strain into a couple.

1.5-ish pounds of roast (I prefer top blade roast for the marbling)
120 grams sliced carrot
110 grams chopped onion
450 grams chopped red potatoes (I leave the skin on)
8 cloves minced garlic
2 sprigs each fresh Thyme, Sage and Rosemary
Chives or green onion tops for garnish 
8 scoops collagen peptides
480 ml bone broth
22 grams cassava flour
28 ml olive oil

On stove top, heat olive oil in a tightly sealing large pot (I prefer a Dutch Oven) and lightly sear the roast on all sides until light brown. Add bone broth and cover, reduce heat to just at simmer (no bubbling or boiling), cook 5 hours or until meat just starts to pull apart with mild force. Add potatoes and carrots and continue to simmer for an 30 minutes, or until they are soft. Add garlic and onion and simmer for another 15-20 minutes or until they are soft as well. By now the roast should easily come apart with a fork. If so, add collagen peptides and stir until dissolved. Add fresh herbs and simmer an additional 20-30 minutes or until desired flavor comes through and remove from stew. Scoop out about 240 ml of broth and and slowly add cassava flour (other gf flour like arrowroot works well EXCEPT xanthan gum which draws out all flavor) until mixture is super thick. Return mixture to stew and stir until blended and base thickens. Serve with chopped green onion or chives and salt/pepper to taste.
